whatItIs: NaturesMud Chia Seeds (300 GM value pack) are triple-cleaned, high-swell black chia seeds (Salvia hispanica) free from dust, stones, and immature brown weeds. When soaked in water or milk for 15 minutes, each seed forms a thick, translucent soluble-fiber gel coat, delivering plant-based Omega-3 (ALA), dietary fiber, calcium, and magnesium.
nepaliKitchenUses: Morning Soaked Lemon-Chia Water: Soak 1 tablespoon (12g) of Chia Seeds in a glass of water for 20 minutes (or overnight), then add fresh lemon juice and a pinch of Himalayan Pink Salt.
Creamy Overnight Chia Pudding: Stir 2 tablespoons of Chia Seeds into 1 cup of milk or dahi with 1 teaspoon of Dates Powder and top with Dried Blueberries or Mango.
Smoothie & Lassi Thickener: Blend 1 tablespoon into fruit smoothies, mango lassi, or protein shakes.

whoItSuits: Ideal for adults, fitness enthusiasts, office workers seeking sustained morning fullness and soluble fiber, and vegetarians looking for plant Omega-3.
monsoonStorage: Because Chia Seeds absorb up to 10–12 times their weight in liquid, even a drop of water inside the pack will cause them to gel. Always scoop with a completely dry spoon and seal tightly.

faqs.q: How do I eat Chia Seeds safely (चिया सिड्स कसरी खाने)?
faqs.a: Always soak 1 tablespoon of Chia Seeds in at least 1 glass (250ml) of water or milk for 15–20 minutes until they form a soft gel before drinking. Never swallow dry spoonfuls of chia seeds followed by water.

faqs.q: Are Chia Seeds and Tukmaria / Babari ko Biu (Basil Seeds) the same?
faqs.a: No. Tukmaria (sweet basil seeds) are jet-black, tear-shaped seeds that swell instantly in 2 minutes. True Chia Seeds are oval with grey/black mottling, take 15–20 minutes to gel, and contain significantly higher Omega-3 fatty acids.

faqs.q: How much Chia Seeds should I take per day?
faqs.a: 1 to 2 tablespoons (12g to 24g) per day soaked in water, milk, yogurt, or oats is the standard daily serving for adults.

faqs.q: How long does one 300 GM pack of Chia Seeds last?
faqs.a: At 1 tablespoon (12g) per day, one 300 GM pack provides 25 daily servings (nearly a full month).
